source.method: Direct watch skill review of downloaded public video, sampled frames and native caption transcript
source.watch_frame_engine: 60 uniform frames after scene-aware extraction fell back, plus 18 pinned five-second midpoint frames
source.limitations: Frames are sampled, so subtle camera motion and exact cut times cannot always be established. Native captions stop at about 1:24, before the final reveal. Music, sound effects and uncaptained speech were not evaluated. Time of day and original character prompt are unavailable. Character blocks are analyst-observed descriptions, not creator-provided specifications.
